split_coco: split COCO dataset into labeled and unlabeled subsets for semi-supervised object detection
parse_args: parse command-line arguments for data root, output directory, labeled percentage, and fold count
run_split_coco_parallel: run parallel COCO splits across multiple folds and labeled percentages using track_parallel_progress
create_labeled_unlabeled_splits: create labeled and unlabeled annotation JSON files from COCO train2017 annotations
generate_kfold_splits: generate k-fold cross-validation splits with configurable labeled data percentages
